key_audit_matters: Non-compliance with IND AS 116 'Leases' due to unavailability of complete lease documentation and discount rate computation inputs.
Non-compliance with IND AS 109 'Financial Instruments' due to lack of historical credit risk and effective interest rate data for ECL modelling.
Non-compliance with IND AS 115 'Revenue from Contracts with Customers' due to inability to segregate sales returns and contract modifications per performance obligation framework.

We did not find any significant matter during the course of the audit and the same has been communicated to the management of the company. Accordingly, it has been determined that nothing has been found to report under this heading.
qualifications_or_emphasis: The company's premises on lease basis, has debtors, sales returns and loan liabilities during the year. The company being listed on stock exchange is required to comply with the IND AS116 'Leases', IND AS-109 'Financial Instruments' and IND As-115 'Revenue from Contract with Customers'. The data available with the company is not sufficient to quantify the effect, of non-compliance, on the standalone financial statements.
